Name: Shipping Bin Summary
Author: futro114
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/apBq2td.png[/img]

[size=5]﻿Futroo's [b]Shipping Bin Summary[/b] Mod[/size][/center][left]
A simple mod that adds a small tooltip when you hover your mouse over the Shipping Bin. If the shipping bin is empty - it will show "empty", otherwise it will show the cash you get for selling all the items in the Shipping Bin.[/left]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ecAIupZ.gif[/img]﻿[/center]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ye2M97d.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Unzip the .zip with the mod to the Mods folder in the game's root directory.
3. launch SMAPI.



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ATni1oQ.png[/img]﻿[/center]
The Shipping Bin Summary mod was tested on game version 1.5.6 and SMAPI 3.18.6, and should work on other versions as well. It should be compatible with most other mods, but there may be some conflicts with mods that modify the shipping bin or its functionality.



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/U573TZE.png[/img][/center]
[b]1.0.1[/b] - Fixed a tooltip display error when the interface scale changed.



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dg8RLzU.png[/img][/center]
